title: From flow to evidence
voice: Playwright Studio turns test flows into automation and real evidence.
caption: A complete QA workflow. No external AI API required.

title: Choose your application
voice: Enter your application URL, reopen an existing project, or select Try demo for a ready-made example.
caption: Application URL  •  Open project  •  Try demo

title: Select a login profile
voice: Choose a role. Use Edit to save its username and password, then select that profile for the run.
caption: Role → Username / email → Password → Save profile

title: Write steps in order
voice: Write actions in order: log in, click, fill, select, and check. Finish with visible text and API status assertions.
caption: Quote labels and values. Separate actions with semicolons.

title: Choose the session policy
voice: In Advanced settings, choose a fresh or saved session. Set a login success marker, or inspect a manual browser session.
caption: Fresh = clean context  •  Saved = dedicated profile  •  Manual capture = inspection only

title: Select your deliverables
voice: Choose Python, Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript. Include a test plan and select your output folder.
caption: Four frameworks  •  Optional test plan  •  Your output folder

title: Run the real workflow
voice: Click Run test. The browser follows your sequence, creates the task, and verifies the response. This is actual demo footage.
caption: Actual browser recording from this demo run

title: Read every step outcome
voice: Results show each step's outcome. Failed steps stop dependent actions instead of reporting false success.
caption: Passed, failed and skipped outcomes reflect actual execution.

title: Inspect the full report
voice: Open the full report. Filter results, expand a case, and distinguish executed tests from advisory plans marked not run.
caption: Filter → Expand a case → Review the step results

title: See what actually happened
voice: Inspect screenshots, recorded video, API responses, and the downloadable Playwright trace. Evidence stays with each report.
caption: Screenshots  •  Video  •  API status  •  Playwright trace

title: Take the project forward
voice: Review the test plan and generated files. Reopen the project for numbered runs, or run exported suites from the command line.
caption: Test plan + source files  •  Numbered runs  •  CLI execution

title: Stop the login loop
voice: For login loops, inspect redirects and unauthorized responses. The runner stops after one attempt and skips dependent steps.
caption: Login → Dashboard → Login  /  Stop + diagnose  /  No automatic retry

title: Set up. Run. Review. Reuse.
voice: Playwright Studio. Ready for your next test.
caption: A complete workflow, from setup to reusable tests.
